ترتشفين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشِفِينَ (tartašifīna) /tar.ta.ʃi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# تُرْتَشَفِينَ (turtašafīna) /tur.ta.ʃa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
